reads.headline: Rams force short throws and their 4-man rush is heating up (42% sack-or-hit last game), but Love has still produced with 2-3 line starters out (288, 372 yds in Weeks 8-9). Since Week 6 every TE1 caught 5+ against the Rams. Without Nacua the Rams lean on the backs, and Corum has out-gained Kyren 3 straight. Green Bay leaks to WR1s (+21 yds over usual). Injuries: Parsons Questionable (off PUP); Donald and Garrett no designation. Love gets the ball out in 2.50 s (league 2.87). The Rams allow few explosive catches (2.3 a game, 4th fewest). Rams corners McDuffie (2.9 yds/target, 43% caught) and Forbes (2.5) shut down WR1s: 3.3 catches and 43 yds a game vs 4.4 and 54 usual, under in 6 of 9. WR2s catch about 1 more than usual. Soft spots: safeties Curl (76% caught, 8.5 yds/target) and Kinchens (80%, 10.2). Outside check (@loebsleads video): Rams man/match + two-high and targeted in the slot at a top-10 rate; Golden has the slot volume; Rams 9 sacks in 2 games since Garrett's return, Kobie Turner set to return.

picks.why: Green Bay's WR1 and deep-left leaks with Nacua/Adams out
13-22 yds in each of his last 5; Packers allow the 2nd-fewest TE yards (4.2 catches, 41 yds a game; no TE over 4 catches or 52 yds all season)
